create_tensorboard_logger: create a TensorBoardLogger instance that writes scalar metrics to a specified log directory path
log_scalar_to_tensorboard: log a single scalar value with a tag name and step to the TensorBoard logger
log_dict_to_tensorboard: log a dictionary of multiple scalar values at once to the TensorBoard logger
log_hparams_to_tensorboard: log hyperparameters and their corresponding metrics to the TensorBoard logger for experiment tracking
flush_tensorboard_logger: flush pending TensorBoard logs to disk to ensure all metrics are written immediately
